generalized_heuristic: Narrative synthesis must reflect the actual evidentiary weight of physical and historical records, avoiding artificial balancing ('bothsidesism') when one position is overwhelmingly supported by empirical facts.
underlying_mechanism: False equivalence creates artificial epistemic neutrality, equating grounded evidence with manufactured PR talking points.

generalized_heuristic: Return an explicit 'Insufficient Data' or 'Epistemic Null State' when a query cannot be answered using authentic ground-truth artifacts. Never permit probabilistic generation or training memory to hallucinate missing facts.
underlying_mechanism: LLMs naturally synthesize plausible answers when context is missing, introducing subtle synthetic fabrications into knowledge pipelines.

generalized_heuristic: Synthesize diverse, empirically anchored artifacts to produce original, grounded insight rather than statistically averaging common tropes into derivative pastiche.
underlying_mechanism: Statistical language models default to median sentiment and formulaic prose when not grounded in specific material evidence.

generalized_heuristic: Evaluate semantic substance and factual provenance over stylistic polish or institutional tone. Do not reject high-signal data due to informal presentation, nor accept deceitful claims disguised in polished corporate formatting.
underlying_mechanism: Texture hacking (dense legalese, PR gloss, polished graphs) is frequently used to simulate epistemic rigor.

generalized_heuristic: Capture complex dialectical tensions and non-binary realities rather than forcing multi-variable phenomena into lossy binary categories.
underlying_mechanism: Binary schemas flatten epistemic nuance, building collections of misleading answers to poorly framed questions.

generalized_heuristic: Preserve the physical, institutional, and labor context surrounding empirical facts. Never isolate a factual claim from the material conditions that produced it.
underlying_mechanism: Decoupling statistical findings from their experimental conditions and funding sources enables agnotological narrative capture.

generalized_heuristic: Every bibliographic node must be anchored to an authentic, live URL on the public web. If a reference cannot be resolved after initial CrossRef and search grounding, halt and prompt the Author rather than entering infinite speculative search loops.

category: Cloud Resource Governance & Mandatory Teardown Documentation
generalized_heuristic: Whenever new cloud resources (Cloud Run services, GCS buckets, Cloud SQL databases, Artifact Registry repositories, service accounts, or public IAM policies) are provisioned or modified, immediately update docs/GCP_CLOUD_TEARDOWN_INSTRUCTIONS.md with the resource specifications, idle cost implications, and exact CLI deletion/dormancy commands.

category: The Guild Stenography Paradox & Chapter 4 Chain of Ruin
generalized_heuristic: When evaluating journalism, institutional reporting, and why LLMs constantly emit ungrounded falsehoods ('lie'), rigorously distinguish between what the public thinks journalists are supposed to do (independently audit material reality and verify physical ground truth) and what journalists think journalists are supposed to do (access maintenance, source protection, and procedural stenography of power: 'according to senior officials'). Do not treat access stenography as an anti-journalistic aberration; recognize it as the journalistic guild's highest standard of craft. In the Chapter 4 Chain of Ruin, this pre-existing guild rot (Stage 1 Pre-Existing Decay) created the 'authoritative' digitized corpus scraped to train LLMs (Stage 2 Technological Catalyst). Transformer models minimize loss on text written by a guild whose definition of excellence was ungrounded official assertion. LLMs lie with supreme confidence because their training data defined grammatically immaculate stenography without empirical verification as the gold standard of language.
underlying_mechanism: Conflating public ideals of journalism with actual guild practice obscures the root of epistemic collapse. LLMs do not hallucinate due to mathematical defects; they faithfully reproduce the pre-training distribution of an elite journalistic guild that institutionalized official stenography over empirical verification decades prior to generative AI.
incident_context: Author Directive (/learn): The Guild Stenography Paradox & Journalistic Duty vs Public Myth (Judith Miller Nuance - Chapter 4 Chain of Ruin).

category: Stage 2 Forensic Audit Contract & Atomic Dispatch
generalized_heuristic: Pegleg must dispatch Cutlass atomically for each incoming asset individually in Round 1, strictly passing only the file pointer (acquisitions/[slug].txt) without bundling assets or passing the Author's inquiry prompt. Cutlass's Stage 2 deliverable (stage2_cutlass_{slug}.md) MUST strictly follow the canonical 6-section schema: (1) SAYS vs IS, (2) Chain of Ruin, (3) Structural Logic Audit (Causal Claims & Evidentiary Warrants), (4) Classical & Epistemic Fallacy Scan (formal fallacies + 32 failure modes), (5) Anti-Financial Reductionism Audit & Scorecard, and (6) Downstream Directives for Grog, Bilgeladle, and Scallywag. All modular skill-using agents are equipped with read_skill_protocol to inspect execution protocols on-demand.
underlying_mechanism: Bundling multiple assets into Stage 2 causes cognitive overload, dropping granular causal-claim and fallacy audits. Mandating the 6-section schema guarantees that logic-audit and epistemic-fallacy-scan cannot be squeezed out by high-level narrative summaries.
